params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of items to retrieve per page.

params.name: include
params.description: A comma-separated list of related objects to include in the response. Valid values are `policyholder`, `policies`, `collection_module`.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by payment method type. Valid values include `debit_order`, `card`, `eft`, `collection_module`, or a custom external payment method key.

params.name: banv_status
params.description: Filter by BANV status. Accepts multiple values.

params.name: policyholder_ids
params.description: Filter by policyholder IDs. Accepts multiple UUIDs.

params.name: payment_method_ids
params.description: Filter by payment method IDs. Accepts multiple UUIDs.

params.name: dismissed
params.description: Filter by dismissed status. Set to `true` to include only dismissed payment methods, `false` to exclude dismissed payment methods.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of payment methods for the organization. Use the `include` parameter to include related objects in the response.

params.name: keys
params.description: Filter by external payment method type keys. Accepts a comma-separated list of keys.

items.docs: Returns a list of external payment method types configured for the organization. External payment method types allow you to define custom payment methods with their own collection logic and outbound channels.

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the payment method.

items.docs: This endpoint validates the input and updates the status of a payment method, which will result in a `200 OK` successful response, with the updated payment method in the response.

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description: Must be a UUID. The unique identifier of the payment method.

items.docs: Dismisses a payment method, marking it as no longer active. Dismissed payment methods are excluded from standard queries unless explicitly requested.

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description: Must be a UUID. The unique identifier of the payment method.

items.docs: Manually verifies a payment method, setting its BANV status to `verified`. This is useful when verification has been performed through an external process.

params.name: mandate_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the DebiCheck mandate.

items.docs: Retrieves a DebiCheck mandate by ID.
